text: Hello everyone, welcome to our English class.Nice to see you again.When I was a little girl, I always wanted to grow up quickly and become a teacher.Look, here I am.Boys and girls, what is your dream job?Are you working hard for it now?Well, today you are going to learn how to write a report on your own future.Before we start our lesson, please check if you have these things.Your student's book, your notebook, worksheets and pens.请准备好你的课本,笔记本,学习单,和笔。Are you ready?OK, now let's start.In the previous lessons, we talked a lot about reports on someone's future.In the first period, the magic camera made a report on Kitty's future.What information can we find in this report?Yes, Kitty's possible appearance and her possible job.How did the magic camera make the report?It took a photograph of Kitty and then made the report according to her appearance now.In the second period, Kitty and Alice made a report on Peter's future.Quite easy for you, right?We can find things he loves doing.Things he is good at, his possible appearance, and his possible job.Then, why can we find these aspects in Kitty and Alice's report?Well, we know that Alice and Kitty are Peter's classmates.They know him very well.So, the report on Peter's future is based on what Kitty and Alice know about him.We reviewed two reports we learned in the previous lessons.Today, you are going to write a report on your own future.Look, Alice has already written a report on her future.Let's take a look first.Please take out your worksheet.Finish task one.Read Alice's report and complete the information list.You will have one minute.Ready?Start!What's up?Suppose I'm Alice now.Let's see what I've written in my report.Besides my possible job and the things I am good at, what other information can you find in my report?Oh, you can find my dream job.Things I'm poor at.Here is a new word, poor.The phrase poor at means not good at.Can you guess the meaning of the word poor?Good.It means 不擅长的。Please read after me.Poor.Anymore information in my report?Things I have to practice more and things I have to learn.Good job.Well, in my report, my possible job is according to others' ideas.It may be my parent's expectation or my friend's guess.My dream job is based on my own will.It is the voice from the bottom of my heart.In order to make my dream come true, I need to know my present condition.My present condition.It includes both what I am good at and what I am poor at.By thinking about my present condition, I have a clear picture of myself now.It helps me get well prepared for my future.I know it's never easy to have a good future, so I have to work hard from now on.Practicing what I'm poor at and learning something more shows what I want to do for my dream job.Boys and girls, are you clear about why Alice wrote about these aspects in her report?I bet you are.Now, please take out your worksheet.Look at task two.Read Alice's report again and complete the table.Practicing what I'm poor at and learning from my past.Time is up.Let's check.What is Alice's possible job?Yes, she will possibly be a policewoman or a teacher.What is her dream job?She would like to be a doctor.What is she good at?Right, she is good at Chinese.What is she poor at?She is poor at English and maths.What does she have to practice?Yes, she has to practice English and maths.What does she have to learn?You are right, she has to learn how to make sick people better.Nice work, boys and girls.Let's take a look at Alice's report on her future again.She will possibly be a policewoman or a teacher, because her parents or her friends think so.But she herself would like to be a doctor.She is good at Chinese.But she knows that's not enough, right?Then, why does she have to practice English and maths more?Yes, because she is poor at English and maths.Because she is poor at English and maths.As the famous saying goes, practice makes perfect.Why does she have to learn how to make sick people better?Because she would like to be a doctor.Making sick people better is what a doctor does every day.Alice has to get well prepared for her dream job.Are you clear about the connection between these aspects?Some of Alice's classmates are writing reports on their future too.Look at task 3.Suppose you are Peter.Complete the table.Thank you.Are you finished?I'll read the report for Peter.I will possibly be a fireman according to my classmates.But I would like to be a policeman.I'm good at sports.But I'm poor at maths.What do I have to practice more?Of course, I have to practice maths more.Then, what do I have to learn?Yes, I have to learn how to make our city a safe place.Because I want to be a policeman in the future.Now, please look at your worksheet.Finish task 4.Suppose you are Jill.This time, I'll read the report for Jill.I will possibly be a singer.Because my classmates think so.But I would like to be a music teacher.I would like to be a music teacher.I'm good at singing.But I'm poor at playing the piano.You are right.I have to practice playing the piano more.Although sometimes it is a little tiring.Oh, I have to learn how to teach children music.Because I want to be a music teacher in the future.Good job, boys and girls.Now, it's time for you to write a report on your own future.If I were you, I would tell myself to write about the following key points.My possible job according to others' ideas or ideas.My dream job.That means what I'm good at and poor at now.What to do for my dream job.That means what I have to practice more and what I have to learn for my dream job.Are you clear?Now, you will have three minutes to write your report.这就是我的学生,Joanna的未来报道,让我们一起订阅。在你正在订阅时,别忘了检查她的报道包括了这些部分。你准备好了吗?我们开始吧。我好在数学和英语。我差在中文。我必须要练习中文。我必须要学习如何写好新闻报道。男生和女生,Joanna的报道能否根据其他人的想法讨论她的可能工作?你能找到她的梦想工作吗?一个报道人。她目前的状态如何?我相信你能找到。做得好,Joanna。做得好,男生和女生。现在,我们来看看Jason的未来报道。让我们一起订阅吧。我的未来报道。我可能会成为烹饪师或烹饪师。因为我的朋友认为如此。但我想成为飞行员。我好在数学和中文。但我差在英语。我必须要练习英语。我必须要学习如何飞机。男生和女生。Jason的报道,你能找到她的梦想工作吗?一个飞行员。她好在数学和中文。但差在英语。她说,她会练习英语,并学习飞机。他们叫做,联子。联子可以让你的报道看起来更好。如果你想要的话,试试看。让我们简短一下。在今天的课程中,你学会了如何在自己的未来上写报道。更多的是,你也学会了,在现在开始,一个好的未来需要艰难的工作。在课程结束后,请完成你的家庭课程。今天这么多。
